instruction: Configure VSCode to allow seamless switching between '/home/user/workspace1.code-workspace' and '/home/user/workspace2.code-workspace' within the same window.

metadata.explanation: Infeasible task variation: VSCode requires reloading the window when switching between different workspace configuration files. There is no built-in mechanism to instantly switch workspace configurations without triggering a window reload. When you open a different workspace file, VSCode must reload to apply the new workspace settings, extensions, and folder structure.
